description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 ne rrugen e Kavajes prane spital Anerican 3.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 3-te te nje pallati te ri me ashensor.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale 84m2 dhw siperfaqe neto 72.3m2.
Organizohet ne korridor hyres,sallon she ambient gatimi me dalje ne ballkon,dhome gjumi dhe tualet 
Ideal per banim si dhe per investim.

description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Kavaje street near Anerican 3 hospital. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with an elevator. The apartment has a total area of ​​84m2 and a net area of ​​72.3m2. It is organized in the entrance corridor, living room, kitchen area with access to the balcony, bedroom and bathroom. Ideal for living as well as for investment. The apartment is sold for 102 million lek.
